label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
**November 11, 2026**

Dear Neighbors,

My name is Jess Okafor and I live in 5A. I have been at Larkspur Lofts for three years. Some of you saw the note in the lobby about a drone being flown from the roof deck, and I would like to explain what happened.

The drone was mine. I am a wedding photographer, and on Saturday, October 31, at around 4 p.m., I flew a new drone (a Halvard Mini 4) from the roof deck for about eleven minutes. I was testing it ahead of a wedding I am photographing at a vineyard in Dundee. The camera was pointed west toward the river and the Fremont Bridge for the entire flight. It was never pointed at anyone's windows.

That said, I understand why it looked bad. A buzzing object hovering over the courtyard is unsettling when you don't know who is flying it or why. One neighbor told me that children visiting her were frightened by it. I am sorry for that, and sorry to anyone else it worried. I should have let people know beforehand.

If you would like to see the footage, I am happy to show you the full, unedited clip. Knock on 5A or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example.

Our HOA rules do not currently say anything about drones. I will not fly from the roof again until the board decides on a rule, and I will ask that the topic be added to the agenda for the board meeting on Thursday, November 19, at 7 p.m. in the community room. Anyone with a view on it is welcome to come.

I do have one request. The note called me a creep and included my unit number, in a place where every resident and visitor could read it. That was hurtful, and it left me feeling exposed in my own building over something I would gladly have explained. If something I do concerns you in the future, please come and talk to me directly. I will listen.

Thank you for reading this.

Sincerely,
Jess Okafor
Unit 5A

I left Doreen's name and unit out, since she told you that privately and this goes to all 24 units.
